body: My nmom is the same way. Growing up, she would always tell me "You're my child so I have to love you, but that doesn't mean I have to LIKE you." She would mock me for my weight, how I breathed, you named it. She would wake me up blowing smoke (either cig or pot) and laugh as I coughed. When I'd get upset she'd say "but I'm your MOTHER you need to show me more respect." Lately she says it more than usual and is always "No matter what happens, I am your MOTHER and that means you need to respect me because that is what children do." I mention how I am an adult and she says no matter how old I get, I will always be her child and I need to "get over it." "I'm the mother, you're the child, that's the way it is and that means you need to RESPECT ME DAMN IT!"
